title: salvia przewalskii var. mandarinorum
intro: Salvia przewalskii var. mandarinorum, commonly known as Chinese Sage, is a variety of the Salvia genus, a type of flowering plant native to China. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Sage are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and phenolic glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and neuroprotective effects. Studies have identified the key bioactive constituents of Chinese Sage as ursolic acid, oleanolic acid, and quercetin, which contribute to its potential health-promoting properties.
